mentions.name: Browser-based QR/barcode scanner PWA
mentions.description: A no-download SaaS PWA that turns a phone camera into a barcode scanner: scan a QR code to pair, then scan barcodes and the captured data is delivered to the desktop browser in real time.
mentions.problem: Eliminates the need to download or install a dedicated barcode scanner app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a Saas tool aimed to no Download Needed (PWA). Works right in your browser. Just point your phone camera at a QR, then point it at barcodes. Data lands in your desktop browser in real time.
mentions.author: pirateandsavior
